#### Plans and usage

# Cursor Token Rate

Teams on The X Subscription pay a Cursor Token Rate of $0.25 per million tokens on third-party model requests. The rate applies on top of the model's API pricing.

First-party models, including Grok and Composer, are exempt. Individual plans do not pay the Cursor Token Rate.

## How do I avoid the Cursor Token Rate?

Use a first-party model, including Grok or Composer.
